title: [던파] 진(眞) 검귀

inspection.limitation: Observed displayed frames during verified half-speed playback; not a claim of source asset layers or authored frame counts.

observations.feature: Low, rapid horizontal motion; a large flattened crescent has an opaque ink-dark body and a thin bright cyan/white edge; local impact sparks stay on enemies and the blade body dissolves after the pass.
Attacks arrive from different sides around a target. Ground mist, narrow white hit flashes, dark rotary mass and a final upright crescent have distinct timing and planes.
Spatial opening anticipates a piercing horizontal rush. Horizontal, vertical and oblique strokes have different silhouettes, and crossing arcs enclose readable negative space.
Darkened field and portrait herald a stronger technique; two large opposing curved strokes meet. Bright impact peaks are brief, followed by thinner lingering outlines.

A vertical scar remains while diagonal scars accumulate; successive portrait beats accompany the build-up, then a horizontal finish releases the stored shape. It is an accumulation-and-release concept, not a series of identical explosions.

Large skill alternates preparation, opposing entries, crossings and close-up beats, with a final concentrated contact, debris and controlled fade. Foreground cuts and ground response have distinct depth and duration.

newSkillConcepts.label: 흑금 단공
newSkillConcepts.concept: A compressed draw stance releases a piercing pass; a dark split with a gold-white lip stays in world space before tearing into short filaments.
newSkillConcepts.mainShape: Low elongated split; no circular blast as main effect

newSkillConcepts.label: 잔영 삼재
newSkillConcepts.concept: The swordsman commands three solid pose echoes from different angles; their distinct slashes converge, then a vertical cleave closes the field.
newSkillConcepts.mainShape: Three independently timed curved planes enclosing the target

newSkillConcepts.label: 천형 종결
newSkillConcepts.concept: A deliberate two-hand preparation forms one vertical and two oblique scars; an overhead sword strike breaks their shared center and sends a ground pressure wave outward.
newSkillConcepts.mainShape: Accumulating intersecting scars followed by one decisive release

adaptation: Keep the accepted white-coat character, black/gold identity and existing V3 camera, HUD and damage authority. Reference effects and composition principles, not copied game textures, character designs or the same skill order.

priorFeedback.scope: Positive aesthetic feedback on the delivered turn/aerial combo; not blanket approval of future skills.
